#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

const int gigamod = 1000000007;
const double epsilon = 0.00000001;

int check(const string& tgt, const string& src) {
    int n = tgt.length();
    if (src.length() != n) return 0;

    char xDig = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (src[i] == 'X') {
            if (xDig == 0) xDig = tgt[i];
            else if (tgt[i] != xDig) return 0;
        }
    }

    if (tgt[0] == '0') return 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (src[i] != '_' && src[i] != 'X' && tgt[i] != src[i]) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

int compute(const string& sOG, int n, const string& suffix, bool bothXCheck) {
    string s = sOG;
    char last = suffix[1];
    char secondLast = suffix[0];
    bool invalid = false;

    if (s[n-1] != '_' && s[n-1] != 'X' && s[n-1] != last) invalid = true;
    if (s[n-2] != '_' && s[n-2] != 'X' && s[n-2] != secondLast) invalid = true;
    if (bothXCheck && s[n-1] == 'X' && s[n-2] == 'X') invalid = true;

    if (invalid) return 0;

    if (s[n-1] == 'X') {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) if (s[i] == 'X') s[i] = last;
    } else if (s[n-2] == 'X') {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) if (s[i] == 'X') s[i] = secondLast;
    }

    s[n-1] = last;
    s[n-2] = secondLast;

    int count = check(suffix, s);
    for (int num = 0; num < 1000000; ++num) {
        string tgt = to_string(num) + suffix;
        count += check(tgt, s);
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    string sOG;
    cin >> sOG;
    int n = sOG.length();

    if (n == 1) {
        cout << ((sOG[0] == '0' || sOG[0] == '_' || sOG[0] == 'X') ? 1 : 0) << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int answer = 0;
    answer += compute(sOG, n, "00", false);
    answer += compute(sOG, n, "25", true);
    answer += compute(sOG, n, "50", true);
    answer += compute(sOG, n, "75", true);
    cout << answer << endl;

    return 0;
}
